experiments.title: Capture stable estate identities
experiments.description: Run one read-only collector on all three hosts and bind CPU, RAM, storage, GPU UUID, driver, attachment, runtime, and monotonic-clock facts into one digest-addressed snapshot.
acceptance: Three distinct host records are present.
All six accelerator domains are either identified or explicitly missing.
Every unknown remains null with a reason; no inferred topology is promoted.
The snapshot has a deterministic content digest.

experiments.title: Freeze one proven function contract
experiments.description: Choose one already useful local function, initially the confirmed 4060 Qwen route or a deterministic GPU utility, and freeze exact input, output, runtime, cartridge, timeout, cleanup, and refusal semantics.
acceptance: The function has a stable ID and implementation digest.
Input and output schemas reject malformed records.
Runtime, model, flags, timeout, cleanup, and failure meanings are explicit.
A fixture replay returns the same contract-level result.

experiments.title: Measure the event timing envelope
experiments.description: Measure wall-clock offset, monotonic timer resolution, and event timestamp uncertainty across all hosts so overlap and critical-path claims have a defensible clock floor.
acceptance: Each host reports wall and monotonic samples.
Pairwise offset and jitter bounds are retained.
Experiments refuse precision finer than the measured envelope.

experiments.title: Measure storage, network, and VRAM paths
experiments.description: Build the actual path matrix for cold storage, host RAM, GPU memory, and host-to-host transfers using cartridge-sized and handoff-sized payloads.
acceptance: Every measured edge names source, destination, byte count, warm/cold state, and p50/p95.
Unmeasured edges remain unavailable rather than zero-cost.
The matrix distinguishes bulk cartridge traffic from compact handoffs.

experiments.title: Baseline the frozen function on eligible workers
experiments.description: Run the same bounded fixture across every eligible CPU and GPU route, separating queue, cold start, warm execution, verification, cleanup, and delivery.
acceptance: Each route records eligibility or a bounded refusal.
Cold and warm p50/p95 are separated.
Thermal, memory, and cleanup state are retained.
No route inherits qualification from another device.

experiments.title: Bind exact invocation receipts
experiments.description: Wrap the frozen function so every attempt records function and implementation digest, worker identity, inputs, runtime, timings, outputs, cleanup, and refusal or failure state.
acceptance: A successful run and a forced refusal both produce valid receipts.
Changing a covered input changes the receipt identity.
The accepted result is not inferred from process exit alone.

experiments.title: Make cartridge residency observable
experiments.description: Instrument load, ready, execute, retain, evict, and cleanup states for one 3090 and the 4060, including retained layers and mutable state.
acceptance: The worker state distinguishes empty, loading, ready, busy, draining, and failed.
Immutable weights are never copied back merely to evict them.
Readiness is probed before admission.
Cleanup leaves a measured known state.

experiments.title: Measure the cartridge rotation matrix
experiments.description: Measure sequence-dependent transitions among empty, same-family, different-adapter, and different-cartridge states on each heavy worker.
acceptance: Transition identity includes from-state, to-state, path, retained layers, and byte movement.
Cold, warm, and partial-layer p50/p95 remain separate.
Failed readiness and rollback are represented.

experiments.title: Fit the first receipt-derived p95 model
experiments.description: Derive queue, hydration, rotation, execution, verification, and delivery distributions from receipts without introducing a learned routing policy.
acceptance: Every estimate cites the receipt cohort and sample count.
Missing distributions remain unknown rather than imputed.
Placement predictions expose all terms and uncertainty bounds.

experiments.title: Keep distinct useful cartridges on both 3090s
experiments.description: Run independent useful work with a different cartridge resident on each 3090 and verify that the estate gains concurrency without pretending they form transparent 48 GB VRAM.
acceptance: Both cards remain independently addressable.
No mandatory tensor exchange sits on the path.
Concurrent wall clock beats the serial baseline for the selected pair.
Residency and cleanup receipts close for both workers.

experiments.title: Qualify one compact branch handoff
experiments.description: Have a CPU, iGPU, or 4060 produce one compact structured artifact that a 3090 consumes, with no central broker copying the full input or a large intermediate tensor twice.
acceptance: The handoff schema is stable and bounded.
Producer and consumer cite the same artifact digest.
Direct consumer pull is used where possible.
The handoff reduces or does not increase critical-path wall clock against the serial baseline.

experiments.title: Hide one successor rotation under useful work
experiments.description: Stage a successor cartridge in host RAM while another worker or branch computes, then compare reactive rotation against just-ahead preparation.
acceptance: External and internal setup are separately timed.
Prepared state is discardable without invalidating the run.
Non-overlapped p95 setup is lower than the reactive baseline.
Prefetch does not starve the running operation or another admitted path.

experiments.title: Separate work, WIP, and prepared capability
experiments.description: Represent committed work, mutable work in process, mounted capability, warm capability, kitted capability, and prepared options as different ledger objects with independent limits.
acceptance: A prepared cartridge does not consume a work token.
Mutable WIP has an owner and recovery boundary.
The ledger refuses silent category collapse.
Synthetic over-release is detected.

experiments.title: Admit one downstream capacity token
experiments.description: Authorize a transition between two cells only when projected downstream capacity, residency compatibility, and delivery window are available.
acceptance: A valid token names route pair, capacity basis, window, expiry, and revocation.
Blocked downstream state refuses upstream release.
Expired tokens cannot be replayed as current authority.

experiments.title: Fill slack without stealing the successor window
experiments.description: Run same-family backfill only when p95 completion plus cleanup fits before the latest safe rotation time, and cancel it when the activation event arrives early.
acceptance: Backfill has a computed latest finish time.
Early successor arrival cancels or refuses backfill.
The critical successor misses no deadline in the fixture campaign.
Cancellation and cleanup are receipted.

experiments.title: Replay one failed step on an alternate worker
experiments.description: Force a bounded worker failure after input admission and resume the step from recorded state on a different qualified route without rerunning upstream work.
acceptance: The failure is explicit and bounded.
The alternate route reuses exact input and checkpoint digests.
Upstream accepted work is not replayed.
The final retirement record preserves both attempts.

experiments.title: Issue one conditional rotation lease
experiments.description: Prepare and authorize the next 3090 machine state before the current operation finishes, with activation event, setup budget, capacity token, expiry, and bounded fallback.
acceptance: The lease names from-state, candidate next-state, activation, expiry, setup budget, and fallback.
The host agent can execute the transition without a control-plane round trip.
Late or absent activation follows the recorded fallback.
Every state transition is receipted.

experiments.title: Execute out of order and retire deterministically
experiments.description: Allow two ready branches to execute in estate-optimal order while retaining provisional outputs until dependencies, provenance, and acceptance contracts are satisfied.
acceptance: Execution order may differ from semantic commit order.
A missing dependency blocks retirement without deleting the provisional artifact.
Retirement binds exact branch receipts and join inputs.
Replaying the same fixture produces the same authoritative retirement order.

experiments.title: Run a rolling-horizon two-3090 schedule
experiments.description: Plan and execute a short real graph where one 3090 computes, the other rotates or runs an independent branch, setup is hidden, backfill is bounded, and the roles reverse.
acceptance: The schedule is issued as coarse local subgraphs, not kernel-level commands.
At least one setup interval is hidden beneath useful work.
No unnecessary central synchronization barrier is introduced.
p95 run wall clock beats the reactive serial baseline for the selected graph.

experiments.title: Qualify the three-host heterogeneous fabric
experiments.description: Execute one real coarse graph across the three CPU and RAM islands, iGPU or 4060 preparation, both 3090 residency surfaces, storage locality, fallback, and deterministic retirement.
acceptance: All three host agents execute bounded local subgraphs.
Data movement follows known object locations and measured paths.
One forced worker failure recovers without whole-run replay.
The accepted result and every non-accepted attempt retire under one source-bound ledger.
The measured wall clock does not regress against the best simpler qualified route.

cost_semantics.operator_minutes: Estimated direct human attention, used only after admissibility and value comparisons.
cost_semantics.machine_minutes: Expected occupied machine time for the bounded experiment.
cost_semantics.new_packages: New runtime dependencies introduced by the experiment.
cost_semantics.data_moved_gib: Approximate deliberate test traffic, not retained evidence size.
cost_semantics.risk: 0 read-only or synthetic; 1 bounded reversible runtime disturbance; 2 multi-host integration disturbance.
cost_semantics.irreversible: 1 only when an experiment cannot be cleanly removed or replayed. All seeded experiments are reversible.

claim_boundary: The catalog is a deterministic planning floor. A listed experiment is not operationally complete until its acceptance artifacts exist and are ingested as evidence.
